v.1: By the heaven, and by the nightly visitor
v.2: (and what will show you what is the nightly visitor?
v.4: there is a guard over every soul.
v.5: So let man consider from what he was created.
v.6: He was created from an effusing fluid
v.7: which issues from between the loins and the breast-bones.
v.8: Indeed He is able to bring him back [after death],
v.9: on the day when the secrets are examined
v.10: and he shall have neither power nor helper.
v.13: it is indeed a conclusive discourse,
v.15: Indeed they are devising a stratagem,
v.16: and I [too] am devising a plan.
v.17: So respite the faithless; give them a gentle respite.
